stories.headline: Gold Slips Below $3 , 700 as Fed Signals More Rate Hikes
Japan core inflation soars to highest this year as energy subsidy expiry pushes up consumer prices
stories.summary: The core inflation figure — which strips out prices of food — was lower than the 2.3% expected by Reuters-polled economists.
